thesis: Robust constraints justify using laws without settling whether laws govern, summarize or express powers.
role: Survey metaphysical alternatives and state critical realism of constraints.

ideas.statement: Best-system summaries, universals, dispositions and primitive laws locate explanatory stopping points differently while sharing experiments.
Critical realism of constraints accepts resistant relations and stable interventions without inferring a legislator, ultimate necessity or unique description.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Cartwright emphasizes conditions for transporting results; constructive empiricism limits commitment while structural realism selects it.
